about: Measured quantities the mapper can code: blood tests (domain 'blood', the default), urine test strip ('urine') and echocardiography measurements ('echo'). A row is only matched against entries of its own domain. One entry per analyte; one code per LOINC property (mass vs moles, ...). 'units' lists the UCUM units a code accepts with the range of values a living person can have in that unit (a value outside it is a transcription or unit error, not a diagnosis). 'names' are printed names, matched without case or diacritics. Edit with the paper-catalog skill, then run tools/loinc_check.py. An entry with no codes is a quantity the catalog knows and deliberately does not code ('reason' says why): it is stored with its printed name only.
